items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names and JSDoc are mostly clear ("Adds a named `window` definition to the query."). But the dialect code uses a single-letter variable in business logic: `windows.map((w) => sql`${sql.identifier(w.name)} as (...)`)`, repeated in all five dialects.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: There is one shared buildWindowSpecSql/validateWindowName, but the ~20-line .window() body (with its SelectionProxyHandler callback resolution) is copy-pasted into all five select.ts files, and the windowsSql block is duplicated in each dialect.ts.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Validates at the boundaries: ntile/nthValue reject 0, negative, 1.5 and NaN with the function name; preceding/following reject bad input; frame order is checked; empty and whitespace-only window names are rejected. All 130 hidden tests pass.

items.name: Public API additions are additive and consistent across dialects
items.name_zh: 公共 API 新增保持向后兼容且各方言一致
items.evidence: Purely additive: an optional `windows?: WindowDefinition[]` field on each *SelectConfig and the same .window() on pg/mysql/sqlite/gel/singlestore. windowsSql is undefined when no windows are set, so SQL for existing queries is unchanged. All 566 existing (P2P) tests pass.
